read.thesis: Aggregates shipments up 12% to a Q1 record on QUIKRETE asset exchange, but organic volume +7% and ASP flat at $23.70 with gross profit per ton down 14%; FY26 Adj. EBITDA guidance held at $2.43bn midpoint.

triggers.label: QUIKRETE asset exchange closed
triggers.quote: on February 23 we closed our largest aggregates acquisition to date through an Internal Revenue Code Section 1031 asset exchange

triggers.label: Aggregates ASP flat at $23.70
triggers.quote: Average selling price (ASP) of $23.70 per ton was in line with the prior-year quarter
triggers.highlight: in line with the prior-year quarter

triggers.label: Organic shipments +7%
triggers.quote: Organic aggregates shipment growth of 7% meaningfully exceeded expectations

triggers.label: FY26 Adj. EBITDA reaffirmed $2.43bn
triggers.quote: we are reaffirming our full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations guidance of $2.43 billion at the midpoint

guidance.quote: we are reaffirming our full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations guidance of $2.43 billion at the midpoint

Organic COGS/ton +5.6%
